hooks.name: Run just check at the end of every activity

action.prompt: End-of-activity quality gate for the home-dashboard repository. Do these steps before you finish. 1. Tests: if this activity changed code in app/, scripts/, tests/ or frontend/src/, make sure tests cover the change. Add or update pytest tests in tests/ for backend changes and vitest tests (frontend/src/**/*.test.ts) for frontend logic. A behaviour change without a test is not finished. 2. Run `just check` from the repository root. It runs ruff lint and format check, mypy, bandit, pytest, tsc, vitest and the vite build. 3. If it fails, fix the root cause, use `just fix` for ruff lint and formatting findings, then run `just check` again. Repeat until it passes. Never make it pass by deleting or skipping tests, loosening tool configuration, or adding noqa, type: ignore or nosec without a short reason on the same line. 4. If `just check` already passed in this activity after your last file change, do not run it again. 5. If a failure can only be fixed by changing what the user sees or how the dashboard behaves, stop and ask the user first. Remember that production is a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with 512 MB RAM: do not add heavy dependencies to fix a check. Finish with one line: `just check: passed` or `just check: failed - <reason>`.
